Sandbox._EnvironmentUrl_comment: When set, the harness re-registers the sandbox env at this URL via reg-web-app before tests. In CI set via McpE2E__Sandbox__EnvironmentUrl=%DeployedUrl%.
Sandbox._ApplicationPoolName_comment: Optional explicit IIS pool for the destructive uninstall-warning proof. TeamCity reads its ApplicationPoolName build parameter automatically.
Sandbox._DatabaseProvider_comment: Set to postgresql to enable PostgreSQL catalog assertions (McpE2E__Sandbox__DatabaseProvider=postgresql in CI).
Sandbox._ClassicSchemaDefaultSectionSchema_comme: Classic section whose LIVE body declares static list columns (a getGridDataColumns / initColumnsConfig override). Required for get-classic-list-columns to prove the schema-default branch against a real Classic body — the test self-ignores while this is blank, so the ticket's discrimination criterion (a reconfigured section and a never-touched one returning DIFFERENT source values) does not run. No base Studio section is known to declare them, so the stand has to seed one; set McpE2E__Sandbox__ClassicSchemaDefaultSectionSchema in the TeamCity build parameters once it does.
Sandbox._ClassicEntityDefaultSectionSchema_comme: Counterpart of the above: a Classic section NEVER configured with static list columns, asserted to resolve to entity-default. Defaults to ContactSectionV2, which a sandbox run confirmed is bare. Override via McpE2E__Sandbox__ClassicEntityDefaultSectionSchema on a stand where Contact IS configured.
